cover.scope: XY agrees in both sources; thickness is the shop 1.80 mm front optical-layer callout, not a certified complete curved-glass section.

frontToRearPlaneReferenceMm.scope: Conflicting side-view dimension arrows retained. Midpoint is a visualization choice, not a measured value. Rear connectors extend beyond these reference planes, so neither value is claimed as maximum assembly depth.

facts.method: Retained original CAD/dimensioned source measurements and registered photographs; unknown values and visual estimates are explicit.
facts.notes: This is a dimension/photo reconstruction, not manufacturer CAD. The inspected complete fixed repository tree and canonical resources did not expose CAD, but this bounded search is not a claim that no official CAD exists elsewhere. SKU35471 includes a separate lithium battery; SKU35356 (-EN) omits it. This model shows the documented bare board/display assembly only. Battery, external speaker, cable and battery mounting are not reconstructed. Official shop and docs dimension images disagree: PCB37.13×29.84 versus37.12×29.83 mm, and side reference6.70 versus6.40 mm. Both unchanged sources remain available. The rendered6.55 mm reference is explicitly their midpoint, not a measured value. Both sources agree on glass41.13×33.13 and AA32.63×27.97 mm in their landscape drawing. The model uses a rigid portrait arrangement, preserving the dimensions; rounded corners clip normalized framebuffer UVs without stretching. Glass, AA and PCB corner radii are visual estimates. The shop drawing4×R1.00 callout is retained but its local feature identity is not certified, so it is not repurposed as a global PCB or display corner radius. PCB thickness, internal face, traces, laminate, component heights, small passives and connector contacts are UNKNOWN or simplified. The inner PCB is labeled UNKNOWN and exposed by inspection. Rear component photographs show appearance without certifying PCB revision or hidden geometry. The curved glass edge is simplified as a constant-thickness rounded plate; no optical refraction or exact edge curvature is claimed. Only BOOT is bound to runtime input boot, GPIO28 active-low. RESET remains geometry only; PWR is through TCA EX4 and is not exposed as a fictitious ordinary GPIO button. Official front imagery is a reference only. Its displayed UI is not used as a runtime texture or claimed as simulated framebuffer output. Optical text-to-USB orientation has not been physically calibrated. Runtime frame shape240×280 is preserved; the chosen model orientation does not certify viewing-angle or touch-to-glass alignment. The0.008 mm live-screen offset avoids rendering overlap and is not a physical layer thickness. Repository commit timestamps are source timestamps, not evidence of device release date. No lost pre-reset model or acceptance result is reused.
facts.uncertainty: Known outlines retain manufacturer dimensions. Unknown thickness, package heights and debug layout estimates are not manufacturing measurements.

collectionNotes: 当前公开入口为项目 SRAM 诊断；原厂 ROM／Flash 启动当前停在尚未实现的 PMU 寄存器，原始镜像作为独立来源参考。
原生和公开 Worker／WASM 已验证完整 8 MiB PSRAM、GDMA 显示、触摸 1024 像素和 BOOT 44928 像素反馈，6 个阶段与原生画面逐字节一致；浏览器 WebGL 未验收。
物理设备无 TF 卡槽；电源键、BQ27220 电量计、I2S 音频、USB、无线和模拟电源尚未实现。
LCD 复位实际由 3V3 上拉，TCA EX1 只复位触摸，按原理图处理 BSP 的共享复位注释冲突。
3D 已根据可用官方资料建立；未声称实物外观或安装尺寸验收。
项目诊断与原厂恢复镜像分别列出；前者不能用于证明后者兼容性。
